mapper.select: select substr(ri.create_date, 1, 4) as yearMonth, count(*) as totCnt from statistic.request_info ri group by substr(ri.create_date, 1, 4) order by yearMonth
select substr(ri.create_date, 1, 6) as yearMonthDay, count(*) as totCnt from statistic.request_info ri group by substr(ri.create_date, 1, 6) order by yearMonthDay

select count(*) as totalCount, count(distinct substr(ri.create_date, 1, 8)) as totalDays, round(count(*) / count(distinct substr(ri.create_date, 1, 8)), 2) as meanCount from statistic.request_info ri;

substr(ri.create_date, 1, 6) not in
